status: analytic lumped/transmission-line model, not EM; connector L/C estimated (no HF data published)

sources.connector: HCTL HC-PBB40C-70DP-0.4V-02, https://www.lcsc.com/product-detail/C19089236.html (mate C19089262); 0.4 mm pitch, 2 x 35, 0.3 A/contact, stack 1.5-4 mm; no SI data

board.stackup: F.Cu 17.5um / 0.196 prepreg FR4 er4.5 tand0.02 / In1 GND / 0.23 core / In2 GND / 0.196 prepreg / B.Cu; total 0.747 mm
board.gnd: one net; solid In1/In2; F.Cu pour excluded inside the finger ring (keepout 9.4x10.2 mm); B.Cu pour
board.die_paddle: pad 75: 4.0 x 5.2 mm GND, 6 x 0.3 mm drill vias to GND
board.fingers: 1.0 x 0.25 mm, 0.4 mm pitch; N/S rows at +-4.7 mm, E/W at +-4.3 mm from centre
board.connector_side: B.Cu, centred under the die; GND contacts 10,18,25,45,53,61 + 4 MP shell tabs
board.passives: 8 x 0201 footprints (C101-C108, labelled 1 uF) on B.Cu edge strips (x = +-6.25 mm), each supply-net to GND; NO footprint on any signal net
board.pads_74_vs_contacts_70: 56 signal + 8 supply sites each own one contact; the 10 die GND bonds share the GND plane (6 contacts + 4 tabs). No functional signal loses a path.

placement_sweep.definition: strip = COB passive strip (shunt-only rework, back-side edge); conn+2mm = carrier just past the connector; car10/30/50mm = 50-ohm carrier line

host_ssn.stagger_2groups: halves bounce for the same edge rate

thermal.paddle_vias: 6 x 0.3 mm drill (0.5 mm pad), GND
thermal.back_side: mezzanine connector U101 occupies the area under the die (B.Cu, centred on the die) -> no plate/coin contact

bond_map_notes.map: pt_rf bond map, integration/chips/rf/bond_map.txt (2026-11-20, after PC-29 / PC-33 / PC-42 and the rf / wired split); sites bonded to VDD / VSS in that map are not pins here
bond_map_notes.names: bond-map names H2D[i] / D2H[i] / SPI_* are listed as H2D_D[i] / D2H_D[i] / HOST_* (unchanged pin names)
bond_map_notes.P_N_order: pad families are placed unmirrored on the east edge (R90): PAD_P is the lower-numbered site (PC-42; pad_wirepad PAD_P traced to its local x 7.5 opening, 2026-11-20)
bond_map_notes.supplies_grounds: board-derived (non-signal nets of the 1x1 mezzanine), not the per-chip VDD / VSS sites of the bond map
bond_map_notes.bond_mm: generator's own pad-centre estimate (211 um pitch on all edges), not the GDS openings; see BOND-AUDIT.md for audited lengths

bond_wire_assumptions.material: AlSi 1 % (0.8 mil, wedge); Au values for the same diameter
bond_wire_assumptions.loop_model: two straight segments: pad -> apex (h above the die face at fraction f of the plan span) -> finger surface (H = die + attach below the die face)
bond_wire_assumptions.length_3d: min = near-end landing with the min loop; nom = finger-centre landing, nominal loop; max = finger-centre landing, max loop; nom_near_end also given
bond_wire_assumptions.L_nH: nom = 0.2*l*ln(4h/d) with h = 0.40 mm above the In1 plane (0.874 nH/mm for d = 20.3 um); min = same with h = 0.22 mm (run-2 F.Cu ground under the wire) on the min length; max = partial self inductance 0.2*l*(ln(4l/d)-0.75) of the max length (no return nearby). Mutual coupling to neighbours and glob-top (er about 3.5-4: no effect on L) not included
bond_wire_assumptions.relation_to_package_channel: package-channel.json bond_mm is the generator pad-centre plan estimate (uniform 211 um pitch); bond_nH_0p83 / bond_nH_1p0 = 0.83 / 1.0 nH/mm times that (0.83 = the same over-plane formula for a 25 um wire). plan_mm.C here is the audited plan length (BOND-AUDIT.md); L_nH.nom = 0.874 nH/mm x length_3d_mm.nom
bond_wire_assumptions.die_shift_cases: x, y in {-0.1, 0, +0.1} mm and rotation in {-1, 0, +1} deg about the die centre (27 cases); rotation is an assumption (hand placement), 1 deg = 56 um at the die corner; fingers fixed
bond_wire_assumptions.source: scratch/pads-core/ws/bond-wire.json (wire.py), pads owner, 2026-11-14: bond wires recomputed with the wafer.space public answers; analytic, not measured
